DecisionRequest.description:
A reviewer's decision on one exact proposal version. The digest is the immutable binding: it must equal the
sealed proposal's `action_digest`. Integers are strict (no strings or floats); unknown fields are refused.
DecisionRequest.title: DecisionRequest

ProposalDetailView.description:
One version, exactly as sealed (`proposal`), with its presentation, consent, decision and derived state.
Resource versions are those read when the proposal was created; they are rechecked at execution, not here.
ProposalDetailView.title: ProposalDetailView

RunEventErrorRaised.description: Replayable error marker: code and identifiers only (the free-form detail stays in the response).
RunEventErrorRaised.title: ErrorRaised

RunEventExecutionChanged.description:
A state change of one approved execution (T19), correlated by execution and operation ID. Carries no
request, address or customer data: the receipt is referenced by its SHA-256 only.
RunEventExecutionChanged.title: ExecutionChanged

RunEventReviewOutcome.description: Factual review projection; identifiers and closed reasons only, never arguments or customer text.
RunEventReviewOutcome.title: ReviewOutcome

csrf.description: Synchronizer token from the JavaScript-readable CSRF cookie. Unsafe methods also need an exact Origin (or, without one, a Referer on the public origin).
